INDEPENDENT MODEL AUDIT, 4:15 PM CHECKPOINT (reach-sequence-disconnect-priority / full-model-disconnect-audit-20261025): NOT complete. Read-only. Source: branch 2d7718add and command_pg.json. What is established now, then the exact remaining scope.

CAUSAL PATH ESTABLISHED (learns / chooses / disabled kept apart)
1. WHAT CHOOSES THE GOAL: present wellness of past moments. goal_ring holds the last 200 model steps (lem_model.py:992). At each planning event the goal is the moment with the highest (normalized) wellness value (4636-4668, best_t = wl_stack.argmax). Wellness CHOOSES WHICH REMEMBERED MOMENT is the goal. It never values a future the body has not lived.
2. WHAT CHOOSES THE COMMAND: distance to that remembered goal, not predicted wellness.
   - Active route (--physical-goals memory, --hand-goals memory): the score is PhysicalGoalCost on the efference head's forecast of one held command (6993-6997), compared with the remembered handle pose.
   - Future wellness entered the command objective only through --prospective-wellness. It was added on 2026-09-09 (61e200ec1: "flag-gated, default off ... may add weight x (1 - predicted wellness of the imagined next state)"; d40f653f1 the same day scored bodily judge columns only). It is off in this command (153-154). Whether it was ever on in an H84 production command is being checked.
3. WHY THE PLAN IS ONE COMMAND: two clamps entered together on 2026-09-24 (ecfc9060f, "Preserve hand and vision repairs with qualified hand choice and takeover handoff"):
   - max_steps = 1 under physical goals, stated reason "Later sensory depths carry the original physical pose; do not present those as future body states" (6995-6997);
   - max_steps = 1 for any hand target mode other than world (7011-7012). The command uses wrist_relative_v1 (301-302).
   - The underlying limit, which _plan_chain states (6927-6931), is that predicted proprioception tokens cannot yet be decoded into physical handle fields. That is an INHERITED gap of the forward model's outputs, not a flag.
   - The earned horizon (2026-09-02, 089bf13da4; 4684-4693) still computes 1 + licensed depths (at most 3), and the clamp then overrides it in the active route.
4. WHEN THE GOAL BECAME A PAST WHOLE-BODY POSE: the route was built on 2026-09-24 (ecfc9060f). Pose-return selection on that route was added on 2026-10-22 (d4a3479a6, "A: pose-return selection on the existing --physical-goals memory route"; the overseer overnight-pose-objective-build-decision-20261022, cited at lem_model.py:6953).
5. WHAT IMAGINATION TRAINS (it LEARNS and chooses nothing in this route).
   - From S(t-3) the forward model is fed its own predictions under the commands actually executed (motor_history), graded at each depth against the raw encoder tokens (3497-3527, _run_imagination_compiled, weight 0.5).
   - Per depth, a win EMA against the do-nothing baseline (persistence of the start tokens) sets the earned license (3531-3581).
   - It trains action-conditioned multi-step SENSORY-TOKEN prediction. It predicts no wellness. Its license is overridden to one command by the clamps above.
6. WHAT PREDICTS FUTURE CONSEQUENCES:
   - the forward model (next tokens of every sense, vision included, so objects appear only implicitly in vision tokens);
   - the efference head (the held command's physical body pose, body only; it drives the active score);
   - self_state (--self-state learn; body-site functioning; trained, loss at 4317-4318; chooses nothing, since --self-choice off);
   - contact_consequences (skin over 5 executed orders; NOT built, since --contact-learning off by default, train_mimo.py:771; its sequence forecast refuses mechanical_v4, consequence_learning.py:142-143).
   No module predicts future wellness and reaches command selection in this configuration.

DISCONNECT SUMMARY (as now understood): the original loop of "remembered best-felt moment -> forward model -> command toward it" never had a learned value of FUTURE wellness in the default path. The prospective term that added one stayed off. Three later changes then each narrowed command selection: the 09-24 physical-pose route and its one-command clamps (prompted by the undecodable proprioception), and the 10-22 pose-return selection. Imagination kept training multi-step sensory prediction that no active route reads. Restoring the original general mechanism therefore needs (a) the forward model's predicted body state usable beyond one command (the stated undecodable-proprioception gap) and (b) a prediction of future wellness feeding command selection. Turning flags on is not that (prospective wellness scores only the imagined NEXT state, 61e200ec1).

REMAINING SCOPE (in progress, two read-only reviewers started at 4:04 PM; one consolidated report follows)
- Wellness channels: every active term's input, formula, output and where each is used (training signal, goal ranking, command objective, log only); persistent memory and any memory beyond 200 model steps; self_state, self_intention, hierarchical self and body function: learns vs chooses vs disabled, with lines.
- History: the original planner objective (lem/live_test.py generate_action and the first lem_model planner); whether --prospective-wellness was ever "add" in an H84 production command; when H84 adopted --physical-goals memory and wrist_relative_v1 and why (decision ids); whether earned horizon > 1 ever reached production commands.
- Not covered by me (the local pass): sensors and encoders -> forward model -> imagination -> planner internals.
